mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audio (audio_url, place_id, image_url, title, script, play_time) VALUES (#{audioUrl}, #{placeId}, #{imageUrl}, #{title}, #{script}, #{playTime})
mapper.select: SELECT a.audio_id AS audioId, a.audio_url AS audioUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.image_url, ''), p.first_image) AS imageUrl, a.title, a.script, a.play_time AS playTime, a.place_id AS placeId, p.add1 AS address FROM audio a JOIN place p ON a.place_id = p.place_id WHERE a.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY a.audio_id ASC
